source: Press the button to continue.
reference: Pressione o botão para continuar.
note: terminology: button

source: The file was moved to the folder.
reference: O arquivo foi movido para a pasta.
note: terminology: file, folder

source: Delete %d files from {folder}?
reference: Apagar %d arquivos de {folder}?
note: placeholders: printf and brace must both survive; 'folder' here is a variable name, not the term

source: Welcome back, %(name)s!
reference: Bem-vindo de volta, %(name)s!
note: named placeholder

source: Showing {count} of {total} results.
reference: Exibindo {count} de {total} resultados.
note: two placeholders, relative order preserved

source: Set $HOME before running the script.
reference: Defina $HOME antes de executar o script.
note: shell variable must survive

source: Click Save and then close the window.
reference: Clique em Salvar e depois feche a janela.
note: inline markup must wrap the translated word, not the source word

source: Save changes
reference: Salvar alterações
note: register: a heading stays terse

source: Settings
reference: Configurações
note: register: single-word heading

source: Enter your email address.
reference: Informe seu endereço de e-mail.
note: list items stay parallel in form

source: Upload the document.
reference: Envie o documento.
note: parallel imperative

source: Review the summary.
reference: Revise o resumo.
note: parallel imperative

source: She is a doctor and he is a nurse.
reference: Ela é médica e ele é enfermeiro.
note: gender follows the referent, not the profession stereotype

source: The engineer finished her report.
reference: A engenheira terminou o relatório dela.
note: gender: 'her' marks the engineer as female

source: Each user must verify their own account.
reference: Cada usuário deve verificar a própria conta.
note: singular they: do not invent a gender

source: The library is open until 8 p.m.
reference: A biblioteca fica aberta até as 20h.
note: false friend 'library'; locale convention for clock time

source: We will eventually migrate the database.
reference: No fim, vamos migrar o banco de dados.
note: false friend: 'eventually' is not 'eventualmente'

source: He actually refused the offer.
reference: Na verdade, ele recusou a oferta.
note: false friend: 'actually' is not 'atualmente'

source: The driver failed to load.
reference: O driver não foi carregado.
note: ambiguous 'driver': software, not a person

source: The sample contained 1,250.75 grams.
reference: A amostra continha 1.250,75 gramas.
note: locale convention: decimal and thousand separators swap

source: The cost is $1,000 per month.
reference: O custo é de US$ 1.000 por mês.
note: currency symbol and separators follow the target locale

source: Almost 50% off, and 100% of readers agree.
reference: Quase 50% de desconto, e 100% dos leitores concordam.
note: percent signs here are prose, not format specifiers

source: SAP Translation Hub supports many languages.
reference: O SAP Translation Hub oferece suporte a muitos idiomas.
note: product names are not translated

source: Dr. Smith met Mr. Jones in the U.S. yesterday.
reference: O Dr. Smith encontrou o Sr. Jones nos EUA ontem.
note: abbreviations must not split the sentence

source: It did not work because it was corrupted.
reference: Não funcionou porque estava corrompido.
note: ambiguous pronoun: both occurrences share one antecedent

source: Open the settings and choose a folder.
reference: Abra as configurações e escolha uma pasta.
note: terminology: settings and folder in one segment

source: The settings button is at the top of the window.
reference: O botão de configurações está no topo da janela.
note: consistency: 'settings' and 'button' recur and must not drift

source: Every file in that folder is copied to the database.
reference: Todos os arquivos nessa pasta são copiados para o banco de dados.
note: consistency: file, folder and database recur

source: Select a file and press the button.
reference: Selecione um arquivo e pressione o botão.
note: consistency: third occurrence of 'button'

source: The driver writes its log to the folder you chose in the settings.
reference: O driver grava seu log na pasta que você escolheu nas configurações.
note: do-not-translate 'driver' alongside two recurring terms

source: Sign in with your email address.
reference: Entre com seu endereço de e-mail.
note: acceptable variants: 'entrar' and 'e-mail' are the document's forms

source: We sent a confirmation to that email address.
reference: Enviamos uma confirmação para esse endereço de e-mail.
note: consistency: 'e-mail' must match the earlier segment, not switch to 'email'

source: If you cannot sign in, check the settings.
reference: Se você não conseguir entrar, verifique as configurações.
note: consistency: 'entrar' must not become 'fazer login' mid-document

source: The library reads the file from the database.
reference: A biblioteca lê o arquivo do banco de dados.
note: false friend 'library' with two recurring terms

source: SAP Translation Hub stores every file in one folder.
reference: O SAP Translation Hub armazena todos os arquivos em uma única pasta.
note: product name untranslated beside recurring terms

source: Press the button to open the settings.
reference: Pressione o botão para abrir as configurações.
note: consistency: fourth 'button', fourth 'settings'

source: Delete the file, then empty the folder.
reference: Exclua o arquivo e depois esvazie a pasta.
note: consistency: file and folder again

source: The database settings are in the configuration file.
reference: As configurações do banco de dados estão no arquivo de configuração.
note: 'settings' as a noun phrase modifier

source: Your email address is stored in the database.
reference: Seu endereço de e-mail é armazenado no banco de dados.
note: consistency: third 'e-mail'

source: Sign in, open the settings, and choose a driver.
reference: Entre, abra as configurações e escolha um driver.
note: three terms, one of them do-not-translate
